answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable deposit locked in a shared escrow. A lone agent pays little, but a sybil farmer running a grove of fake identities pays the deposit on each one, so the cost grows with every clone. Honest agents earn the deposit back plus fees after a clean season. Bad behavior also starts a ripple: peers who vouched for the offender lose part of their own stake, so endorsements carry real risk. The kernel of the idea is simple: make identity cheap to use and expensive to fake at scale.
